subject: prd/docgate
statement: When folding a Q, docgate shall maintain a required boolean `question_answered` in its fold-state and `effective.source.json` unit record: a Q introduced without checkpoint-carried state starts false and a successful `answer Q<n>` sets it true; non-Q records omit the field. When docgate creates, validates, or consumes a rebase checkpoint, it shall copy each live Q's immediately-before value into typed replay-base metadata, restore that value before applying later entries, and have `verify-rebase` compare it with the pre-checkpoint fold, failing any missing, invalid, or unequal value.
rationale: the checkpoint Markdown re-anchors units but neither its free-text Status cell nor the current source-map lineage fields can preserve an answer operation that the replay window no longer contains
fit_criterion: a base Q with arbitrary Status and a fresh post-checkpoint Q each emit explicit false; a ledger with `answer Q1` followed by `002-rebase.md` emits and restores Q1 true while unanswered Q2 remains false; folding the full pre-checkpoint history and folding from the checkpoint produce identical Q classifications and source-map booleans; deleting or flipping either checkpoint value reds `verify-rebase`, deleting or flipping the generated source-map value reds `verify-generated`, and a second faithful checkpoint preserves both values
